name: ox-alpha-workbench-pro
description: منظومة هندسة البرمجيات بالذكاء الاصطناعي — Gemini AI Autonomous Engineering Copilot
author: OX-Alpha Team <naderba69>

scripts.audit: node --check src/app.js && for f in src/features/*.js; do node --check "$f" || exit 1; done && echo '✅ JS syntax OK'
scripts.lint: npx eslint src/ --ext .js || echo '⚠️ eslint not installed — run npm install'
scripts.format: npx prettier --write "src/**/*.{js,html,css}" || echo '⚠️ prettier not installed'
scripts.test: node build.js --minify && node tests/smoke.test.js && node tests/sprint2.test.js
